rate_limits: Typically 5,000 regular requests per day; inspect X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and X-RateLimit-Reset headers for the endpoint/token.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: auditor correct. Official ADS policy states all users (including API) share the same limit—currently 5000 regular requests/day for most request types (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/help/policies/rate-limits). Official adsabs-dev-api docs confirm per-endpoint limits via X-RateLimit-Limit / Remaining / Reset (example Limit: 5000 daily) (https://github.com/adsabs/adsabs-dev-api). Original claim that no fixed public number is published is wrong.
